description: Write dated values to a series (upsert by date). A date is YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC), or a time such as 2026-09-30T14:30Z, floored to the half hour. Use when you compute data yourself. Values are numbers, or short text labels for a text series (e.g. a rating or stance; see Data policy). A series' first write fixes its type.
name: push_points
title: Write series points
